final:
`public/models/toycar.glb` is now 1.53 MB, down from 5.42 MB. On the tool's simulated 4G load, it takes 1.58 s instead of 5.22 s. I haven't loaded the page in a browser. I measured the load time and quality with `node-assets inspect`.

- **Quality:** the fidelity score is 0.983. The tool treats 0.9 or higher as no visible loss. It compares renders of the original and the optimized file at 1024px.
- **What changed in the file:** the geometry is meshopt-compressed, and the PNG textures are converted to WebP at the default quality. Four of the six 1024px textures and both 512px textures were converted. Two 1024px PNGs stayed as they were. Triangle count is unchanged at 108,936.
- **Viewer:** the file now needs a meshopt decoder, so in `src/viewer.js` I imported `MeshoptDecoder` from three's addons and added `loader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder)`. The decoder is about 6 KB gzipped. Because the loader is shared, the other models still load.
- **Not used:** I also tried shrinking the textures to 512px. That saved only about 200 KB (1.33 MB total) and dropped fidelity to 0.978. I didn't think the small gain was worth the extra risk.

`assets/toycar.glb` is untouched, so you can re-run the optimization from the original.
bash_cmds: node-assets --help; ls -la assets public/models src; cat src/viewer.js

node-assets optimize assets/toycar.glb -o /tmp/t_q.glb --force; node-assets optimize assets/toycar.glb -o /tmp/t_m.glb --geometry meshopt --force; for f in /tmp/t_q.glb /tmp/t_m.glb; do node-assets inspect $f --against assets/toycar.glb --view 1024 --network 4g; done

node-assets optimize assets/toycar.glb -o /tmp/t_m5.glb --geometry meshopt --texture-size 512 --force >/dev/null; node-assets inspect /tmp/t_m5.glb --against assets/toycar.glb --view 1024 --network 4g | grep -E "bytes|fidelity|load_s"

cp /tmp/t_m.glb public/models/toycar.glb
python3 - <<'E'
p='src/viewer.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { RoomEnvironment","import { MeshoptDecoder } from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';\nimport { RoomEnvironment",1)
s=s.replace("const loader = new GLTFLoader();","const loader = new GLTFLoader();\nloader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
head -8 src/viewer.js; grep -n Meshopt src/viewer.js
